def get_user_network_nodes_info(self, user_name):
        # type: (Str) -> Dict[Str, Any]
        """
        Obtain the network node association details for the given :term:`User`.

        .. todo::
            Until the API is modified to make it possible to request from the ``NetworkRemoteUser`` table,
            we have to access the database directly here.
        """
        network_remote_users = (self.request.db.query(NetworkRemoteUser)
                                .join(User).filter(User.user_name == user_name)
                                .all())
        existing_network_remote_user_nodes = {nu.network_node_id: nu.name for nu in network_remote_users}
        network_nodes = self.request.db.query(NetworkNode).order_by(NetworkNode.id).all()
        return {
            "network_nodes": [(n.name, existing_network_remote_user_nodes.get(n.id)) for n in network_nodes],
            "network_routes": {"create": schemas.NetworkRemoteUsersAPI.name,
                               "delete": schemas.NetworkRemoteUserAPI.name},
        }
